page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head "VITA" centred at the top, page number "104" at the top left. A footnote below the text, marked (a), with the catchword "Ba-" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: nalem Franciscum Barberinum in qua etiam opusculi illius rationem explicat his verbis{a}: Existimabā necessarium, hu-ic operi (de ordinationibus) nonnulla infe-rere de Ecclesiarum antiquarum figura & forma interiori, ut commodius Episcopi in-Sancto Sanctorū Tribunal, Presbyterorū & Diaconorum ad altare aut circū ædes, aliorum inferiorum Ministrorum in Choro seu Sanctuario Confessus, fidelium tam virorum quam mulierum extra chorum distincti ordines, variaqve pœnitentium post ambonem stationes explicarentur. Cum autem interior illa figura & structura non parum illustrari possit templi Hierosolymitani, quale erat Jesu Christi & Apostolorum secuto, comparatione; multa enim ad illius exemplar instituerunt primi Ecclesiæ fundatores, nonnulla etiam de illius delineatione cogitaveram : verum quod pauculis Capitulis me posse conficere sperabam, fœcunditate materiæ in molem excrevit, ideo separato libello hæc edere constitui. Hujus quoque opusculi de
{a} Mor. Epist, ad Card, Fr. Barb.

page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout. Small-caps-like title "VITA" read as running head. The first word "nalem" is a fragment from the previous page and is kept as printed. Doubtful readings: "viorum" (read as virorum), "autem" (the printed form looks like autem with a tilde or ligature). The "Sancto Sanctorū" line has a barely visible space, read as two words. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
